description: This file defines the PromoteApiController class, which handles API requests related to project promotion management in the Goteo platform. It includes actions for promoting projects, reordering promotions, and updating promotion properties.

classes.name: PromoteApiController
classes.description: Controller for managing project promotions via API endpoints in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: validatePromote
methods.description: Validates user permissions and retrieves a Promote object by ID.

methods.name: promoteSortAction
methods.description: Handles reordering of a promotion's position.

methods.name: promoteAddAction
methods.description: Adds a new promotion to a project for a specific channel.

methods.name: promotePropertyAction
methods.description: Updates a property of a promotion object.
